$comment: Gate C acceptance criteria — ADR 0010 (D7). Fixed before measurement.
Note on ADR numbering: tenant isolation is ADR 0010. ADR 0015 is the RTL
frontend. Evidence records must cite 0010 so a failure routes to the decision
Unlike Gates A and B this has no thresholds — isolation is binary. Any probe
that succeeds in reaching another tenant's data fails the gate outright.
$minimumEvidenceRationale: Isolation cannot be established by static analysis or unit tests with fakes. A fake that models RLS correctly proves only that the fake is correct. PASS requires real Postgres.
$negativeControlRationale: Every probe must be demonstrated to FAIL against a deliberately broken schema. A probe never observed failing may be passing vacuously.

outcome.onPass: ADR 0010 isolation model validated at integration-test confidence.
outcome.onFail: ADR 0010 REOPENED. A successful probe is a cross-tenant breach path. Halt feature work on the affected plane until closed.
